findings.evidence: `DegreeImage.lean:73` proves `(weightedDegreeClass w h).range = AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range w)` and `DegreeImage.lean:87` gives the general top-range corollary; `DegreeImageSplitting.lean:52-54` separately proves the weight-one instance with `AddMonoidHom.range_eq_top.mpr (S.weightedDegreeClass_surjective w h hx₀)`.
findings.fix: Import `DegreeImage` here and derive this lemma from `weightedDegreeClass_range`/`weightedDegreeClass_range_eq_top` by showing `1 ∈ AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range w)` from `hx₀`, rather than reproving the special case from `weightedDegreeClass_surjective`.
findings.issue: `weightedDegreeClass_range_eq_top_of_weight_one` is proved directly from weight-one surjectivity even though the PR also adds the general image theorem and general top-range corollary.

summary: The main image theorem is at the natural closure-of-weights level, but one weight-one corollary duplicates a special case instead of going through the new general API.
